_comment: icraft #57: boss-only Tetra material from Cataclysm's Ancient Remnant. HIGH primary / spell power, deliberately LOW durability (750 vs aethersteel's 2500) so the weapon wears down -- and since ancient_metal_ingot only comes from the Ancient Remnant, the ONLY way to repair a remnant-bladed weapon is to refight the boss. Mirrors the aethersteel schema. (For the shipped pack this can move into datapack_sources/icraft_tetra_materials + a jar rebuild; kept in kubejs/data here so it's live for testing.)
